description: Fork of exp585 (E=192 full arch, 1.4625, new LUT-LM SoTA). TWO coupled changes: E 192 -> 384 AND d_v 32 -> 64. Preserves H*d_v=E invariant (6*64=384) so out_proj stays square. D stays at 384 (head unchanged). All else identical to exp585/exp567: per-layer residual_lut NAP=6 tph=128 (now E=384 -> D=384, both equal), untied Linear(D=384, V). Continues the productive E-sweep on the proven full-arch recipe. Predicted ~261M params (+105M vs exp585: tok_emb +6.29, v_lut +23.59, out_proj +75.50). Predicted trunk ~146 Mbits (+50 vs exp585, still 2.3x cheaper than vanilla's 340). Total bandwidth ~549 Mbits/tok (26% cheaper than vanilla's 742). E=384 matches vanilla's residual width — the cleanest 'LUT-LM at vanilla scale' iso-E reference. Refs: exp567 1.4768 @103M (E=96), exp585 1.4625 @156M (E=192), exp581 ~1.51 (E=384 minimal arch — failed), exp328 1.3882 (vanilla E=384). Expected to beat exp585 if E-widening still has slope-positive value, plateau if returns are diminishing.
